description: NaMgP(CO₃)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.51 Å. Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent PCO₃ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.40 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.26 Å) and one longer (1.27 Å) C-O bond length. In the second C site, C is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one P and one O atom. The C-P bond length is 1.85 Å. The C-O bond length is 1.24 Å. P is bonded to one C and three O atoms to form distorted PCO₃ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-51°. All P-O bond lengths are 1.53 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Mg and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Mg and one C atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one P atom.
